text:
What is your name, night of this night?

Tell me your name. Leave me

your sign and password

so that I may recognize you

always

through other different nights.


You offer me her forehead in half-moon

(half-moon of flesh),

her lips (pulp in shadow)

and her profile to the touch...

(Tomorrow my right hand

will play at drawing her outline in the air.)


What is your name, night of this night?

Tell me your name, leave me

your sign and password

so that I may recognize you

always

through other different nights.

And so I may call you joyfully,

trembling,

by your name!

translation.title: Nocturne
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the nocturne's repeated request for the night's name and sensual password.
